evidence: Crystal structures of the ﬁlms were identiﬁed from X-ray diffraction (XRD) patterns measured either in q–2q or in grazing incidence (GIXRD) mode with a PANalytical X’Pert Pro X-ray diffractometer. The surface morphology of the ﬁlms was examined using a Hitachi S-4800 ﬁeld emission scanning electron microscope (FESEM). The ﬁlm thicknesses were determined from X-ray reﬂectivity (XRR) patterns measured with a Bruker AXS D8 Advance diffractometer and from energy-dispersive X-ray spectroscopy (EDX) data. For atomic force microscopy (AFM) studies, a Veeco Instruments Multimode V with Nanoscope V controller was used. Elemental compositions of the ﬁlms were determined with time-of-ﬂight elastic recoil detection analysis (TOF-ERDA) by a 1.7 MV Pelletron accelerator using a 8.515 MeV 35Cl4+ ion beam.
